privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what information Dull collects, why, and how it's handled. Dull is an educational/demo e-commerce project — this isn't a binding legal document, but it accurately reflects what the site actually does.

dataCollected.title: What we collect
dataCollected.account: When you sign in with Google, we receive your email address and name from your Google account.
dataCollected.orders: When you place an order at checkout, we collect the shipping details and order information you enter (name, address, phone, and the items ordered).

thirdPartySignIn.title: Third-party sign-in
thirdPartySignIn.body: Sign-in is handled by Google Sign-In. Additional sign-in options (such as Facebook Login) may be added in the future.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We use a single httpOnly session cookie to keep you signed in. It's used only for authentication — we don't use cookies for tracking or advertising.

payments.title: Payments
payments.body: Checkout on Dull is entirely simulated. No real charge is ever made, no credit card details are collected, and no payment processor is involved.

howWeUse.title: How we use your information
howWeUse.body: Your information is used only to run the site: to sign you in, to show your order history, and to display the shipping details you entered for an order.

dataSharing.title: Data sharing
dataSharing.body: We don't sell your information to anyone. It isn't shared with third parties beyond the sign-in provider you chose to use.

contact.title: Contact & data deletion
contact.body: To ask a question about your data, or to request it be deleted, email {{email}}.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: If this policy changes, the update will be posted on this page.

about.title: About Dull
about.body: Dull is a streetwear e-commerce project offering shirts and footwear inspired by classic band-merch design.

notRealStore.title: This is a demo, not a real store
notRealStore.body: Dull is an educational/demo portfolio project. Orders placed here are not real orders — nothing is shipped, and no real payment is ever taken.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use
acceptableUse.body: Please use this site respectfully and don't attempt to abuse, disrupt, or misuse it or the accounts of other users.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual property
intellectualProperty.body: The band logos and names referenced on this site are used as a non-commercial homage and belong to their respective owners — see the <disclaimer>Disclaimer</disclaimer> page for details. All other design and content on this site belongs to its creator.

noWarranty.title: No warranty
noWarranty.body: This site is provided as-is, as a demo project, without warranties of any kind.

changes.title: Changes
